posts.title: NRL-Predict: An experiment to predict NRL winners and scores
posts.description: As a bit of an experiment I built NRL-Predict a machine-learning project which tries to predict NRL-games. It uses past-performance and player injuries, considering the impact of each player on the game to determine who will win and the predicted score. The score is normalised based on what is typically seen in rugby league matches […]
